faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for NIT Nagaland Research Assistant Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application form for the Research Assistant post at NIT Nagaland is 28 September 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for Research Assistant posts?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy for the Research Assistant position in the NIT Nagaland recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q3. What is the application mode for NIT Nagaland Research Assistant?
faq.answer: The application mode for the NIT Nagaland Research Assistant recruitment is Offline. Candidates need to send their applications to the specified address.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary for the Research Assistant post at NIT Nagaland?
faq.answer: Selected candidates for the Research Assistant post will receive a salary of Rs. 13200 per month.

faq.question: Q5. What are the educational qualifications required for Research Assistant?
faq.answer: Candidates must have B.E./B.Tech and M.E./M.Tech or equivalent in Mechanical/Production and Computer Science with at least 65% marks or 6.5 CGPA.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for NIT Nagaland Research Assistant recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for the NIT Nagaland Research Assistant recruitment.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for Research Assistant at NIT Nagaland?
faq.answer: The selection process for Research Assistant includes Application Screening followed by Document Verification.

faq.question: Q8. Where is NIT Nagaland located?
faq.answer: NIT Nagaland is located in Dimapur, Nagaland, with the pincode 797103.

faq.question: Q9. When was the notification for NIT Nagaland Research Assistant released?
faq.answer: The official notification for the NIT Nagaland Research Assistant recruitment was released on 18 September 2026.

faq.question: Q10. How can I download the official notification PDF?
faq.answer: You can download the official notification PDF from the Important Links section provided in this article.
